steps.instruction: Prepare a 10-point, 3-fold serial dilution of CHEMBL5426285 starting at 10 µM in DMSO, plus vehicle (0.1 % DMSO) and reference inhibitor (CHEMBL1952329 at 1 µM) controls.
Add kinase (HASPIN) at 5 nM, peptide substrate at 20 µM, ATP at its Km (≈50 µM), and compound dilution; incubate 30 min at 30 °C.
Stop reaction with ADP-Glo reagent, deplete ATP for 40 min, then add detection reagent and incubate 60 min; measure luminescence.
Normalize luminescence to vehicle (100 % activity) and reference inhibitor (0 % activity); fit a four‑parameter logistic curve; report IC50 with 95 % CI and assay Z’ factor.

rationale: The concentration range spans well above the highest reported IC50 for similar HASPIN inhibitors (≈770 nM) to ensure full inhibition; a 3‑fold dilution yields adequate curve shape; triplicate wells provide statistical power; ADP‑Glo luminescent readout is validated for kinase assays.
limitations: Assumes recombinant HASPIN activity reflects native enzyme; does not account for cellular permeability or off‑target effects; ATP concentration set to approximate Km may not reflect physiological ATP levels.
